title: Elastic vs Inelastic
text: In elastic collisions, objects bounce apart and kinetic energy is conserved. In inelastic collisions, objects may stick together and some kinetic energy is converted to other forms.

title: Conservation of Momentum
text: Total momentum before = Total momentum after. This applies to ALL collisions in isolated systems.

title: What We Know
text: Before: 2 kg at 6 m/s, 4 kg at rest. After: 2 kg at -2 m/s, 4 kg at unknown velocity v. Use conservation of momentum to find v.
